title: SkyrimNet SexLab
description:
Provides the actions and prompts needed to support sexlab animations in SkyrimNet.

## Features
- npc/hotkey can start sex, cuddle, punishment scenes
- ability add scene descriptions
- mini-sexgame
- Injury Engine support
- May ask/order/punish actor
- DOM support

## Required

- SexLab Framework (vanilla or P+; P+ Separate/enjoyment-wait scenes are capped so LLM scenes end)
- Papyrus MessageBox
- JContainers v4.2.13.1+
- SkyUI SE
- UIExtensions
 - UIExtensions_UITextEntryMenu_with_VR_support (VR)
- MageLight UI
 - Media Keys Fix
- Animation utilities: Pandora, XPMSSE, SL Animation Loader, Hug kill move fix for USSEP
- Ace Animations (cuddle/spooning)
author: goodprovider
changelog:
### AnimDB
- Fixed: human casts got creature animations at the last stage and in the Scene Creator
- A load that finds an interrupted animation database build restarts it
- A new game no longer rebuilds an animation database that already has animations

### SexLab P+ (untested)
- Fixed: a save made during the animation database build crashed the game on load
- Saves that already hold the bad data are not repaired

### Diary of Mine 8.5.6d
- Fixed: the DOM handler uses Diary of Mine 8.5.6d's values for arousal and step rolls
